claims.object_text: volume reductions in substantia nigra and striatum
claims.quote: Volumetric reductions were detected in substantia nigra and striatum of GluN1KD mice at all ages.

claims.object_text: degenerating neurons in twelve-week old GluN1KD mice
claims.quote: FluoroJade immunofluorescence revealed degenerating neurons in twelve-week old GluN1KD mice.
The evidence of degenerating neurons in the mature brain indicates an ongoing process of cell loss as a consequence of NMDAR hypofunction.
